prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.signedDistance = function(input)
Behavior: Parse canonical a;b, where each field is one signed decimal integer in -1000..1000. Return the absolute distance between a and b as a decimal string. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: -4;7 returns 11.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const nums=s=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};exports.signedDistance=function(s){let q=s.split(';');if(q.length!==2)return null;let x=nums(q[0]),y=nums(q[1]);if(!x||!y||x.length!==1||y.length!==1)return null;let p=[x[0],y[0]];let[a,b]=p;return String(Math.abs(a-b))}
